# UX Requirements Quality Checklist: Warrant X-Ray

**Purpose**: Formal release-gate review (before implementation) of the user experience, evidence panel, and accessibility requirements.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | detail: [requirements.md](../../../requirements.md) | design: [plan.md](../plan.md), [tech_spec.md](../../../tech_spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Audience**: Reviewer / QA. **Depth**: Formal Release Gate. **Focus**: Warrant Card, Scenario Slider & Curves, Compare Table, Evidence Panel, Responsive Sheet, Accessibility (WCAG AA).

## Warrant Card & Metrics: Completeness & Clarity

- [ ] CHK001 Are visual presentation requirements defined for both the "Issuer says" and "We recompute" side-by-side columns, including alignment and decimal precision? [Completeness, Req §FR-UI-10, §FR-CARD-01]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the visual difference threshold for the issuer-mismatch indicator quantified across all compared metrics (IV points, delta, effective gearing), rather than just IV? [Clarity, Req §FR-UI-10, §FR-XCHK-01]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the visual states of the holding-cost bar specified for all three components (spread cost, flat decay, IV-crush loss) when one or more components evaluate to zero or unknown? [Coverage, Req §FR-UI-12, §FR-CARD-02]
- [ ] CHK004 Does the specification define the layout, placement, and dismiss behavior for flag chips displaying measured values versus thresholds? [Clarity, Req §FR-UI-11, §FR-FLAG-01]
- [ ] CHK005 Are visual requirements specified for expired warrants and warrants expiring on the current trading day, prohibiting forward-looking cost projections? [Edge Case, Req §FR-CARD-08]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the UI rendering requirement defined for metrics with an `unknown` status so that a specific reason code is always displayed rather than a blank or generic dash? [Completeness, Req §FR-UI-13, §FR-CARD-07]

## Scenario Panel & Curves: Clarity & Consistency

- [ ] CHK007 Are the discrete step increments, slider tick marks, and input debounce timings explicitly quantified for all three scenario sliders (move, days, vol shift)? [Clarity, Req §FR-UI-20, §FR-SCN-01]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the curve styling requirements (colors, stroke styles, legends) defined to distinguish the three time horizons without relying on color perception alone? [Consistency, Req §FR-UI-21, §FR-UI-07, §FR-SCN-04]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the breakeven move annotation requirement specified for cases where the breakeven point lies outside the visible -20% to +20% chart boundary? [Edge Case, Req §FR-UI-21, §FR-SCN-03]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the requirements for the "loading while keeping previous result visible" state specified with explicit opacity or spinner indicators? [Clarity, Req §FR-UI-22]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the specification define how typed scenario inputs between ±20% and ±50% adjust or rescale the chart x-axis domain? [Clarity, Req §FR-UI-20, Spec §SC-007]
- [ ] CHK012 Are mathematical model assumptions required to appear directly below the chart specified with exact wording and citation markers? [Completeness, Req §FR-UI-23, §FR-SCN-06]

## Warrant Comparison & Search: Consistency & Layout

- [ ] CHK013 Is the attribute ordering in the comparison table defined to ensure identical row sequence regardless of the order warrants are selected? [Consistency, Spec §User Story 6, Req §FR-CMP-02]
- [ ] CHK014 Are layout requirements defined for adding, removing, and switching comparison slots up to the 3-warrant maximum limit? [Completeness, Req §FR-UI-30, §FR-CMP-01]
- [ ] CHK015 Does the specification explicitly prohibit any visual ranking, highlighting of "best" value, or sorting within the comparison view? [Clarity, Spec §User Story 6, Req §FR-CMP-03]
- [ ] CHK016 Are empty-state search requirements defined for stocks that have zero listed warrants, showing the nearest alternatives? [Coverage, Req §FR-UI-35, Req §FR-SRCH-04]

## Chat Stream, Evidence & Navigation: Interaction Flow

- [ ] CHK017 Are auto-open panel transition requirements defined when chat text introduces or discusses a warrant card, including animation and scroll behavior? [Interaction, Req §FR-UI-03]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the interaction flow specified for clicking `[E#]` reference markers in chat, detailing how the Sources tab highlights the corresponding evidence record? [Interaction, Req §FR-UI-04, §FR-CHAT-05]
- [ ] CHK019 Are visual requirements specified for the chat status step indicators while tools are executing before answer tokens arrive? [Clarity, Spec §SC-010, Req §FR-CHAT-03]
- [ ] CHK020 Are export and copy-to-clipboard interactions specified, ensuring the mandatory regulatory disclaimer is automatically appended to the exported text? [Completeness, Req §FR-UI-08, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the data badge UI specified with clear visual distinctions between live, replay, stale, and synthetic sample data modes? [Clarity, Req §FR-UI-05, Spec §FR-002]

## Responsive Layout & Mobile Behavior

- [ ] CHK022 Is the exact viewport width breakpoint defined for transitioning between the dual-pane desktop layout and the mobile bottom-sheet overlay? [Clarity, Req §FR-UI-06, Tech §10]
- [ ] CHK023 Are gesture, drag, and dismiss interaction requirements specified for the mobile evidence sheet while preserving active chat context? [Interaction, Req §FR-UI-06]
- [ ] CHK024 Are touch-target sizing requirements specified for slider thumbs, chips, and reference markers to meet mobile usability standards (min 44x44px)? [Non-Functional, Req §FR-UI-06]
- [ ] CHK025 Does the spec define responsive table behavior (e.g., horizontal scroll vs card stacking) for the multi-warrant comparison view on mobile screens? [Gap, Req §FR-CMP-02, Req §FR-UI-06]

## Interface States & Error Handling

- [ ] CHK026 Are banner display requirements specified for the "Source Down / Replay Mode" condition, clearly displaying the snapshot timestamp and mode? [Completeness, Req §FR-UI-40, Req §FR-ERR-03]
- [ ] CHK027 Are UI requirements defined for rate-limited users, showing a cooldown countdown timer and disabled submit states? [Clarity, Req §FR-UI-42, Req §FR-ERR-20]
- [ ] CHK028 Does the specification define retry controls and network recovery banners when the SSE chat connection is interrupted mid-stream? [Exception Flow, Req §FR-UI-43, Req §FR-ERR-17]
- [ ] CHK029 Are visual indicators defined on the Data Health tab for displaying daily visits, daily unique visitors, and total interactive query counts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, §SC-011]

## Accessibility & Non-Functional Quality (WCAG AA)

- [ ] CHK030 Are keyboard navigation requirements defined for all custom interactive controls (slider keys, tab cycling, chip selection, sheet dismissal)? [Non-Functional, Req §FR-UI-07]
- [ ] CHK031 Is focus management specified when the evidence panel auto-opens or when a modal sheet opens, preventing keyboard trap or lost focus? [Accessibility, Req §FR-UI-07]
- [ ] CHK032 Are screen-reader ARIA live regions specified for streaming chat status updates and newly received card tokens? [Accessibility, Gap, Req §FR-UI-07, Tech §10]
- [ ] CHK033 Are color contrast requirements (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for graphical objects/chips) explicitly stated in accordance with WCAG AA? [Non-Functional, Req §FR-UI-07]
- [ ] CHK034 Does the specification enforce that all severity levels (warning vs high) and price directions (up vs down) pair icons/text with color? [Consistency, Req §FR-UI-07]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the client-side JavaScript bundle budget requirement (<300 KB gzipped) validated as a gate in CI build workflows? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
